parts:
Write a post about getting excited about 2026 and becoming whatever it is that God has in store for me in this new life, I am posting this picture so make it work with this: I can tell you everything I want from life in 6 words: peace in the pursuit of greatness. It's the most beautiful paradox. Stillness and violence. Being and becoming. Meditation at 6, war at 9. A nervous system so calm I can hear my intuition whisper to me, and ambitions so loud they force me to become someone I've never been. Softness in my chest and fire in my eyes. Nothing much, and absolutely fucking everything. I intend to have my cake and eat it. I simply refuse to choose between the two. That's the mission.

- Jude Fredman

Standing on the edge of 2026 feeling a quiet kind of excitement. Not the rushed kind. The grounded kind.

This next chapter feels less about proving and more about becoming. Becoming who God has been patiently shaping me to be through every hard season, every unraveling, every rebuilding. A new life is forming and I can feel it settling into my bones.

I saw this quote and it stopped me cold because it says exactly what I am claiming for this next year:

“I can tell you everything I want from life in six words: peace in the pursuit of greatness.

It is the most beautiful paradox. Stillness and violence. Being and becoming. Meditation at 6, war at 9. A nervous system so calm I can hear my intuition whisper to me, and ambitions so loud they force me to become someone I have never been. Softness in my chest and fire in my eyes. Nothing much, and absolutely everything. I intend to have my cake and eat it. I simply refuse to choose between the two. That’s the mission.”  
– Jude Fredman

This is the energy I am carrying forward. Peace without shrinking. Ambition without losing my soul. Faith that anchors me and fire that moves me.

2026 is not about choosing between softness and strength. It is about allowing both to coexist and letting God lead me into whatever comes next.
